methodology.processes: Each phase uses a fresh Bun process; cached phases share only persisted data. Native restart uses SIGKILL and a new service process.
methodology.timing: Operation clocks start immediately before IndexManager construction; processWallMs includes module/runtime startup and cleanup.
methodology.bytes: encodedPutValueBytes sums JSON UTF-8 value bytes in committed puts; storage.bytes is live logical JSON bytes; database file sizes are observed allocation, not total disk I/O.
methodology.fixtureStores: Disposable generated fixtures only; removed after each repetition.
